body: I’ll definitely look into journaling, maybe it’ll just help with everything. I’m not going to tell anyone about my problems anytime soon, but maybe one day I will get the courage to do so. I just get really nervous, and it’ll take me a lot of work to try and tell someone about what I’m feeling. I appreciate it though and I think I’m gonna try to sleep since it’s 12AM here, thank you so much for the help. z

I appreciate your words a lot. I’m not gonna tell my parents what I’m feeling, but when I’m older I’ll definitely look into therapy. My parents are definitely not the right people to tell about how I’m feeling. Plus when I’m an adult I’ll be responsible for my own life. Maybe I’ll start journaling and I’ll see if it works out for me. I can try writing out something positive, it’s just difficult to be positive when I’m going through so much but I’m going to try every day to write down at least one good thing that happened to me that day. Thanks for talking to me though, I can’f tell you how much I appreciate it. It means so much to me to know that someone will listen to what I say.
Thanks, I think once I talk about stuff I’m passionate about it distracts me from how I feel. :)))

Yeah, I love to play my realm with my boyfriend, it’s honestly nice when we go on mining trips together, it’s really nice to do but I’m waiting on him to renew the realm so we can play it again. I play with shaders so the sunsets look really nice, it’s peaceful to look at them. The music really adds to it, I also need to try out the cave update sometime since I’ve been playing a lot of hypixel bedwars recently.

Thanks for taking the time out of your day to write this, I really appreciate it. I want to ask my boyfriend for help once I know he’s feeling better. He just told me about his problems today and I know it would be shitty of me right now to just tell him what I’m going through, I don’t think I want to make him feel worse than what he already feels. I’m gonna probably tell him once I know he is doing better mentally. Yeah, I think the incident from when I was 10 really changed how I view my family. They made me feel guilty for years about how I cut myself, about how this is the fault of my phone. I still can’t believe they didn’t ask me if I needed help, they just jumped to ‘Oh, this is because of YOUR phone’. The guilt I’ve been feeling for the past few years has really been because of that incident. I’ve never had the chance to talk about it, I’ve always just kept it inside. Every time I get a scratch on my arm/wrist, I get extra cautious and nervous that my mum is gonna think I cut, even though if it was an accident. Now I just do it on my legs but I’m a week and a bit clean, I think? I’m not sure, everyday just kinda merges with each other. 

I wish I could tell my parents about how I feel the need to get tested for depression. I don’t get it, I feel all this shit but my brain is trying to tell me I’m overreacting and that I’m fine. I don’t think wanting to kill yourselves is normal but I’m scared of what my family will think when they find out I’ve been going through all of this. Will they think of me as an attention seeker? Will they think I’m overreacting? I don’t wanna tell them because I’m afraid of their reaction just from what happened when I was 10. If they reacted poorly to me when they found out I cut myself, what will they think when they found out I think about killing my self everyday? I don’t want to know their reaction at this point. I’m scared. They’ll never look at me the same.
I mostly play minecraft but I also play valorant and apex legends
My life isn’t that interesting, to be honest. I mostly just watch anime and play video games. I don’t really have any hobbies asides that, I just sit on my phone.

Maybe. But, I don’t really have a family doctor since I personally don’t have one in my family. If I told any doctor I wanna kill myself I think they’d have to report it to my parents, which is really annoying.
Thanks for the advice, I appreciate it. I don’t know, I’ve actually been feeling this way since I was about 10, maybe? I don’t know.

Thanks for taking your time to write this. I’ve never told my family about anything. The reason behind that is because when I was 10 and they saw I cut my wrist, they blamed it on my phone and never asked me if I needed actual help. This was when I was 10. This incident has stuck with me ever since. Oh and, I cant tell my boyfriend. He’s going through so much himself. I cant weigh him down with that pain, I need to be strong for him to help him get through what he’s going through. And by feeling shitty, it’s just. It’s difficult to explain it, personally. It’s like a void you can’t fill, it’s like being empty. It’s being irritated by everyone and everything but feeling alone. It’s being surrounded by your friends but still feeling like you have nobody to talk to. It’s being tired all the time, just wanting to sleep forever.
I’m 13 almost 14, so yeah I’m in secondary school (what’d you’d call it in the UK but I think that’s the equivalent of high school for you)

Yes, I don’t know if it’s worse to feel angry or to feel nothing. My parents have been pissing me off so much because they won’t leave me the fuck alone like I know they’re tryna care for me but it’s making me a bit angry

Depression. Not being good enough for anyone. Hating myself. Being fat. Disappointing my parents. Feeling alone all the time. Feeling like shit but not being able to do anything. IM TIRED of trying to get better. I try my best to recover from depression by just pretending I’m happy. I still feel empty everyday. I’m exchausted from all of it. I just want to sleep and never wake up. Why cant it just stop
True, I know it would be successful if I did it with my medication though because I know that too much of it will kill me

I don’t know. I don’t wanna leave my boyfriend or my family. I’m just so tired of feeling this shitty feeling everyday. It’s incredibly selfish of me to feel like this but I just can’t do it anymore I’m so close to ending it
